rules: Every bug found and not fixed goes here. status: open | fixed | waived. severity: field-critical (loses work, bricks the app, or ships wrong data) | major | minor. Ship gate blocks on open field-critical unless director_waiver is set. rank = Director-approved order. A row marked fixed must include lesson: one sentence naming the test that fails if the bug returns.

bugs.title: A failed update can make the app close on every launch
bugs.detail: Relaunch loop when a staged update fails to apply; pending state is never cleared.
bugs.lesson: A failed apply must stop relaunching after the retry limit and clear the staged bundle; scripts/test_updater_safety.py test_no_relaunch_loop fails if the app keeps closing on every launch.

bugs.title: No rollback if copying update files fails partway
bugs.detail: Install folder can be left half old, half new.
bugs.lesson: A failed file copy must leave the live exe and _internal untouched and write the failed marker; scripts/test_updater_safety.py test_bat fails if a half-finished copy stays installed.

bugs.title: A leftover older staged update can downgrade the app
bugs.detail: Staged version is not compared against the running version before applying.
bugs.lesson: An older or unknown staged bundle must be dropped and not applied; scripts/test_updater_safety.py test_no_downgrade fails if a leftover update downgrades the app.

bugs.title: Updating from inside the app skips saving your work
bugs.detail: Updater path calls sys.exit without the normal close/persist sequence.
bugs.lesson: An in-app update must save the shift before exit and must not exit when that save fails; scripts/test_updater_safety.py test_save_before_exit fails if the updater quits without saving.

bugs.title: In-app update helper hung forever: launched with no console, tasklist|find never returned, so the update never installed and the app never reopened
bugs.detail: Found by adversarial review; confirmed old flags never finish from a windowed parent. Now CREATE_NO_WINDOW + tasklist to file.
bugs.lesson: The update helper launched from a windowed parent must finish and install; scripts/test_updater_safety.py test_bat fails if that launch never returns.

bugs.title: OPEN_APP.bat / FINISH_UPDATE.bat installed any staged update with no completeness check
bugs.detail: Launcher now requires update_ready/.complete (written last by the app).
bugs.lesson: A staged bundle without a complete _internal must not be installed; scripts/test_updater_safety.py test_bat fails if an incomplete bundle replaces the live app.

bugs.title: A half-copied staged update (disk full) could be installed and leave an app that will not start
bugs.detail: Found by second review pass. .complete sentinel; partial copy dropped without blocking re-download.
bugs.lesson: A partial ready copy must not be offered and must be removed without freezing that version as a permanent failure; scripts/test_updater_safety.py test_no_downgrade fails if a half-copied update is installed.

bugs.title: Picking in the Together view loses picks and Apply loops
bugs.detail: Together restored an empty pick list, and Apply did not name the day so the pick queue started over.
bugs.lesson: Together must keep the day being picked, and Apply must advance that day queue; scripts/test_route_sections.py test_excel_day_not_only_together fails if picks vanish or Apply starts over.

bugs.title: "Pick order..." resets other days to file order
bugs.detail: Reloading Excel/.EST for a new pick replaced every day's visit order. Other days now keep theirs.
bugs.lesson: Pick order on one day must leave the other day visit order and route in place; scripts/test_route_sections.py test_excel_day_not_only_together fails if another day resets to file order.

bugs.title: Merging days leaves each day's route out of date
bugs.detail: Merge reordered every site but left each day's saved line on the old visit order. Each day is now retraced in the new order; a day that fails to trace drops the old line.
bugs.lesson: Merging days must retrace each day in the new visit order and drop a day that was not traced; scripts/test_route_sections.py test_days_merged_view fails if a day keeps its pre-merge line.

bugs.title: Drive times are wrong when a day filter is on
bugs.detail: Day-filtered time legs were indexed by the full stop list. Route and install clocks now use that day's own order.
bugs.lesson: Drive time with a day filter must use that day own legs; scripts/test_route_sections.py test_day_filter_drive_time fails if filtered clocks use the full stop list.

bugs.title: Pick mode stays active after switching to the Install tab
bugs.detail: Leaving Route pauses pick mode. Install map clicks select the site and Drop pin is available. The unapplied order returns when Route is opened again.
bugs.lesson: Leaving Route must pause pick mode so Install clicks select the site; scripts/test_bug_sweep.py test_pick_pauses_on_install fails if pick mode stays active on the Install tab.

bugs.title: A site ID can falsely match coordinate digits inside a map file
bugs.detail: Site ids match a pushpin name or a whole token. Digits inside a coordinate such as -117.5057 are not a site.
bugs.lesson: A site id must match a pushpin name or a whole token, not digits inside a coordinate; scripts/test_bug_sweep.py test_est_id_not_coordinate fails if a coordinate fragment becomes a site.

bugs.title: Duplicate site IDs: import keeps the first copy, export keeps the last
bugs.detail: Import and export both keep the first copy of a site id. A later copy is written on export only when it has more field work.
bugs.lesson: Import and export must both keep the first copy of a site id; scripts/test_bug_sweep.py test_duplicate_site_id fails if export keeps a later duplicate instead.

bugs.title: A title row above the headers finds zero sites
bugs.detail: The importer scans the first rows for a site/lat/lon header, so a title above the columns is skipped.
bugs.lesson: The importer must find a site/lat/lon header below a title row; scripts/test_bug_sweep.py test_title_row_above_headers fails if a title row yields zero sites.

bugs.title: Large or retried road downloads lose roads that cross tile edges
bugs.detail: Tiles overlap, and each download keeps roads that cross the tile edge. The smaller-tile retry uses the same boxes.
bugs.lesson: A road download must keep roads that cross a tile edge, including the smaller-tile retry; scripts/test_bug_sweep.py test_tile_edge_roads fails if edge-crossing roads are dropped.

bugs.title: Going online freezes the screen during street lookup and can overwrite typed streets
bugs.detail: Street lookup runs on a background thread. A street the operator typed is not replaced.
bugs.lesson: Street lookup must run off the UI thread and must not replace a street the operator typed; scripts/test_bug_sweep.py test_online_street_lookup fails if going online freezes or overwrites a typed street.

bugs.title: local_server reads whole files into memory for every request
bugs.detail: Map responses are streamed in 64 KB chunks, including range reads of the basemap.
bugs.lesson: Map responses must stream in chunks, including range reads; scripts/test_bug_sweep.py test_local_server_streams fails if a request reads the whole file into memory.

bugs.title: volume_report / picocount_hits are O(n^2) (currently unused)
bugs.detail: Hose hits pair in one forward pass. A parsed study stream is skipped instead of re-read at every byte. Volume hours are grouped by day once.
bugs.lesson: Hose hits must pair in one forward pass and volume hours must group by day once; scripts/test_bug_sweep.py test_hit_pairing_linear fails if those scans go quadratic.
